verses.en: What shall we say then that Abraham our father, as pertaining to the flesh, hath found?
verses.pt: Então, que diremos que Abraão, nosso ancestral segundo a carne, obteve?
verses.en_web: What then will we say that Abraham, our forefather, has found according to the flesh?
verses.en_bbe: What, then, may we say that Abraham, our father after the flesh, has got?

verses.en: For if Abraham were justified by works, he hath whereof to glory; but not before God.
verses.pt: Pois se Abraão foi justificado pelas obras, ele tem do que se orgulhar, mas não diante de Deus.
verses.en_web: For if Abraham was justified by works, he has something to boast about, but not toward God.
verses.en_bbe: For if Abraham got righteousness by works, he has reason for pride; but not before God.

verses.en: For what saith the scripture? Abraham believed God, and it was counted unto him for righteousness.
verses.pt: Pois o que diz a Escritura? Abraão creu em Deus, e isso lhe foi lhe imputado como justiça. Gênesis 15:6
verses.en_web: For what does the Scripture say? “Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him for righteousness.”
verses.en_bbe: But what does it say in the holy Writings? And Abraham had faith in God, and it was put to his account as righteousness.

verses.en: Now to him that worketh is the reward not reckoned of grace, but of debt.
verses.pt: Ora, ao que trabalha, seu pagamento não é considerado um favor, mas sim, uma dívida.
verses.en_web: Now to him who works, the reward is not counted as grace, but as something owed.
verses.en_bbe: Now, the reward is credited to him who does works, not as of grace but as a debt.

verses.en: But to him that worketh not, but believeth on him that justifieth the ungodly, his faith is counted for righteousness.
verses.pt: Porém, ao que não tem obra, mas crê naquele que torna justo o ímpio, sua fé lhe é reputada como justiça.
verses.en_web: But to him who doesn’t work, but believes in him who justifies the ungodly, his faith is accounted for righteousness.
verses.en_bbe: But to him who without working has faith in him who gives righteousness to the evil-doer, his faith is put to his account as righteousness.

verses.en: Even as David also describeth the blessedness of the man, unto whom God imputeth righteousness without works,
verses.pt: Desta maneira, também Davi afirma que bendito é aquele a quem Deus atribui justiça independentemente das obras:
verses.en_web: Even as David also pronounces blessing on the man to whom God counts righteousness apart from works,
verses.en_bbe: As David says that there is a blessing on the man to whose account God puts righteousness without works, saying,

verses.en: Saying, Blessed are they whose iniquities are forgiven, and whose sins are covered.
verses.pt: Benditos são os que têm as transgressões perdoadas, e seus pecados são cobertos.
verses.en_web: “Blessed are they whose iniquities are forgiven, whose sins are covered.
verses.en_bbe: Happy are those who have forgiveness for their wrongdoing, and whose sins are covered.

verses.en: Blessed is the man to whom the Lord will not impute sin.
verses.pt: Bendito é o homem a quem o Senhor não atribui pecado.
verses.en_web: Blessed is the man whom the Lord will by no means charge with sin.”
verses.en_bbe: Happy is the man against whom no sin is recorded by the Lord.

verses.en: Cometh this blessedness then upon the circumcision only, or upon the uncircumcision also? for we say that faith was reckoned to Abraham for righteousness.
verses.pt: Ora, essa bendição é somente para os circuncisos, ou também para os incircuncisos? Pois dizemos que a fé a Abraão foi reputada como justiça.
verses.en_web: Is this blessing then pronounced on the circumcised, or on the uncircumcised also? For we say that faith was accounted to Abraham for righteousness.
verses.en_bbe: Is this blessing, then, for the circumcision only, or in the same way for those who have not circumcision? for we say that the faith of Abraham was put to his account as righteousness.

verses.en: How was it then reckoned? when he was in circumcision, or in uncircumcision? Not in circumcision, but in uncircumcision.
verses.pt: Como, pois, lhe foi reputada? Enquanto ele estava na circuncisão ou na incircuncisão? Não na circuncisão, mas sim, na incircuncisão.
verses.en_web: How then was it counted? When he was in circumcision, or in uncircumcision? Not in circumcision, but in uncircumcision.
verses.en_bbe: How, then, was it judged? when he had circumcision, or when he had it not? Not when he had it, but when he did not have it:

verses.en: And he received the sign of circumcision, a seal of the righteousness of the faith which he had yet being uncircumcised: that he might be the father of all them that believe, though they be not circumcised; that righteousness might be imputed unto them also:
verses.pt: E ele recebeu o sinal da circuncisão como selo da justiça da fé quando ainda era incircunciso, para que fosse pai de todos os que creem, ainda que não estejam circuncidados, para que a justiça também lhes seja imputada;
verses.en_web: He received the sign of circumcision, a seal of the righteousness of the faith which he had while he was in uncircumcision, that he might be the father of all those who believe, though they might be in uncircumcision, that righteousness might also be accounted to them.
verses.en_bbe: And he was given the sign of circumcision as a witness of the faith which he had before he underwent circumcision: so that he might be the father of all those who have faith, though they have not circumcision, and so that righteousness might be put to their account;

verses.en: And the father of circumcision to them who are not of the circumcision only, but who also walk in the steps of that faith of our father Abraham, which he had being yet uncircumcised.
verses.pt: e para que fosse pai da circuncisão, dos que não somente são circuncidados, mas que também andam nos passos da fé do nosso pai Abraão, quando ainda não era circuncidado.
verses.en_web: He is the father of circumcision to those who not only are of the circumcision, but who also walk in the steps of that faith of our father Abraham, which he had in uncircumcision.
verses.en_bbe: And the father of circumcision to those who not only are of the circumcision, but who keep to the way of that faith which our father Abraham had before he underwent circumcision.

verses.en: For the promise, that he should be the heir of the world, was not to Abraham, or to his seed, through the law, but through the righteousness of faith.
verses.pt: Pois não foi pela Lei que a promessa de ser herdeiro do mundo foi feita a Abraão ou à sua descendência, mas sim, pela justiça da fé;
verses.en_web: For the promise to Abraham and to his offspring that he should be heir of the world wasn’t through the law, but through the righteousness of faith.
verses.en_bbe: For God's word, that the earth would be his heritage, was given to Abraham, not through the law, but through the righteousness of faith.

verses.en: For if they which are of the law be heirs, faith is made void, and the promise made of none effect:
verses.pt: porque, se é da Lei que são os herdeiros, logo a fé se torna vazia, e a promessa é anulada.
verses.en_web: For if those who are of the law are heirs, faith is made void, and the promise is made of no effect.
verses.en_bbe: For if they who are of the law are the people who get the heritage, then faith is made of no use, and the word of God has no power;

verses.en: Because the law worketh wrath: for where no law is, there is no transgression.
verses.pt: Pois a Lei produz ira, porque onde não há Lei, também não há transgressão.
verses.en_web: For the law produces wrath, for where there is no law, neither is there disobedience.
verses.en_bbe: For the outcome of the law is wrath; but where there is no law it will not be broken.

verses.en: Therefore it is of faith, that it might be by grace; to the end the promise might be sure to all the seed; not to that only which is of the law, but to that also which is of the faith of Abraham; who is the father of us all,
verses.pt: Por isso é pela fé, para que seja conforme a graça, a fim de que a promessa seja confirmada a todos os descendentes, não somente aos que são da Lei, mas também aos que são da fé de Abraão, que é Pai de todos nós,
verses.en_web: For this cause it is of faith, that it may be according to grace, to the end that the promise may be sure to all the offspring, not to that only which is of the law, but to that also which is of the faith of Abraham, who is the father of us all.
verses.en_bbe: For this reason it is of faith, so that it may be through grace; and so that the word of God may be certain to all the seed; not only to that which is of the law, but to that which is of the faith of Abraham, who is the father of us all,

verses.en: (As it is written, I have made thee a father of many nations,) before him whom he believed, even God, who quickeneth the dead, and calleth those things which be not as though they were.
verses.pt: (como está escrito: “Eu te constituí pai de muitas nações”) Gênesis 17:5 diante daquele em quem ele creu, Deus, que vivifica os mortos, e chama as coisas que não são como se já fossem.
verses.en_web: As it is written, “I have made you a father of many nations.” This is in the presence of him whom he believed: God, who gives life to the dead, and calls the things that are not, as though they were.
verses.en_bbe: (As it is said in the holy Writings, I have made you a father of a number of nations) before him in whom he had faith, that is, God, who gives life to the dead, and to whom the things which are not are as if they were.

verses.en: Who against hope believed in hope, that he might become the father of many nations, according to that which was spoken, So shall thy seed be.
verses.pt: Com esperança, Abraão creu, contra as expectativas, que se tornaria pai de muitas nações, conforme o que lhe fora dito: “Assim será a tua descendência”. Gênesis 15:5
verses.en_web: Besides hope, Abraham in hope believed, to the end that he might become a father of many nations, according to that which had been spoken, “So will your offspring be.”
verses.en_bbe: Who without reason for hope, in faith went on hoping, so that he became the father of a number of nations, as it had been said, So will your seed be.

verses.en: And being not weak in faith, he considered not his own body now dead, when he was about an hundred years old, neither yet the deadness of Sarah’s womb:
verses.pt: Ele não fraquejou na fé, não dando atenção ao seu próprio corpo já praticamente morto (pois já era de quase cem anos), nem ao estado de morte do ventre de Sara;
verses.en_web: Without being weakened in faith, he didn’t consider his own body, already having been worn out, (he being about a hundred years old), and the deadness of Sarah’s womb.
verses.en_bbe: And not being feeble in faith though his body seemed to him little better than dead (he being about a hundred years old) and Sarah was no longer able to have children:

verses.en: He staggered not at the promise of God through unbelief; but was strong in faith, giving glory to God;
verses.pt: nem duvidou da promessa de Deus; pelo contrário, fortaleceu-se na fé, dando glória a Deus;
verses.en_web: Yet, looking to the promise of God, he didn’t waver through unbelief, but grew strong through faith, giving glory to God,
verses.en_bbe: Still, he did not give up faith in the undertaking of God, but was made strong by faith, giving glory to God,

verses.en: And being fully persuaded that, what he had promised, he was able also to perform.
verses.pt: e teve plena certeza de que aquele que havia prometido também era poderoso para cumprir.
verses.en_web: and being fully assured that what he had promised, he was also able to perform.
verses.en_bbe: And being certain that God was able to keep his word.

verses.en: And therefore it was imputed to him for righteousness.
verses.pt: Por esse motivo que também isso lhe foi imputado como justiça.
verses.en_web: Therefore it also was “credited to him for righteousness.”
verses.en_bbe: For which reason it was put to his account as righteousness.

verses.en: Now it was not written for his sake alone, that it was imputed to him;
verses.pt: Ora, não só por causa dele está escrito que lhe foi imputado;
verses.en_web: Now it was not written that it was accounted to him for his sake alone,
verses.en_bbe: Now, it was not because of him only that this was said,

verses.en: But for us also, to whom it shall be imputed, if we believe on him that raised up Jesus our Lord from the dead;
verses.pt: mas também por nós, a quem será imputado, aos que creem naquele que ressuscitou dos mortos a Jesus, nosso Senhor,
verses.en_web: but for our sake also, to whom it will be accounted, who believe in him who raised Jesus, our Lord, from the dead,
verses.en_bbe: But for us in addition, to whose account it will be put, if we have faith in him who made Jesus our Lord come back again from the dead,

verses.en: Who was delivered for our offences, and was raised again for our justification.
verses.pt: que foi entregue por nossos pecados, e ressuscitou para a nossa justificação.
verses.en_web: who was delivered up for our trespasses, and was raised for our justification.
verses.en_bbe: Who was put to death for our evil-doing, and came to life again so that we might have righteousness.
